bullets.text: 荷姆茲：AIS 統計 7 日平均 3.3 艘/日，較戰前 81 艘 -96%（資料至 10/25），通行嚴重受阻；油輪與 LNG/LPG 運價的地緣溢價須持續觀察。
bullets.text_en: Hormuz: AIS 7-day average of 3.3 transits/day, -96% vs the pre-war 81 (data to 10/25); traffic is severely disrupted. Keep watching the geopolitical premium in tanker and LNG/LPG rates.

bullets.text: 貨櫃：SCFI 3,687 點（10/30），上漲 6.0 點；Drewry WCI US$4,389/FEU（11/5）。
bullets.text_en: Containers: SCFI at 3,687 (10/30), up 6.0; Drewry WCI US$4,389/FEU (11/5).
Dry bulk: BDI at 2,694 (11/4), daily change +104, -12% over the past month; Capesize 5TC US$37,162/day.

bullets.text: 能源：Brent US$98.88/桶（11/6），年增 +55%；歐洲 TTF 天然氣 €90.00/MWh；油價與氣價水準影響油輪、LNG 船需求與船東燃油成本。
bullets.text_en: Energy: Brent at US$98.88/bbl (11/6), +55% y/y; European TTF gas at €90.00/MWh; oil and gas prices drive tanker and LNG carrier demand and owners' fuel costs.

bullets.text: 成本：新加坡 VLSFO US$902/公噸（11/4），較前日 -40.0；燃油約占航次成本四到六成，留意航商轉嫁（BAF）能力。
bullets.text_en: Costs: Singapore VLSFO at US$902/t (11/4), -40.0 d/d; bunkers are roughly 40-60% of voyage costs, so watch carriers' ability to pass them on via BAF.
